mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 3.0% (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in FEDFUNDS and decline in CPIAUCSL signals a 'soft landing' monetary policy that stabilizes growth without recession, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising labor market (PAYEMS) signals strong economic growth that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1100 thousand units signals weakening consumer spending that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that quickly reduces short-term discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) below 500,000 million dollars signals reduced consumer spending that weakens corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 500000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
